purpose: Teach: 東南アジア/四国/採取/タンパク質/探査/単身/誤差/交易

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、本気で、絶対、東南アジア、絶対、で、絶対、感染症、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、視察しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, your team's inspection of Southeast Asian infection-control protocols was genuinely thorough. Thank you for that.
lines.style: Clear, measured delivery. Precise opening on his name. Warm but professional—the thanks of someone who doesn't overstate. Steady eye contact throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院、本気で、絶対、四国、絶対、出身の、絶対、医師、絶対、多いそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I've heard your hospital has many physicians from Shikoku. Is that right?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, leaning slightly forward. Thoughtful pause before the question—he's working through something he's been wondering. Respectful but not deferential.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。検体の、本気で、絶対、採取、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、慎重に行います、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our team handles specimen collection with meticulous care. It's a priority for us.
lines.style: Steady, informative tone. Each phrase lands with quiet confidence. No rush. The voice of someone explaining something she's overseen many times.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 血液の、本気で、絶対、タンパク質、絶対、検査、絶対、貴院、絶対、進めていらっしゃるんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So your hospital is advancing blood protein assays? I didn't realize you'd moved into that work.
lines.style: Gentle realization in his voice—he's learned something new. Slightly higher note on the question. Sincere interest, not testing. The tone of someone noting down something worth knowing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。新薬の、本気で、絶対、探査、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、研究、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our team is actively researching new therapeutic compounds. It's important work.
lines.style: Patient, grounded tone. Slight emphasis on 'actively'—a quiet insistence on the legitimacy of what they do. Calm authority without strain.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院、本気で、絶対、単身、絶対、赴任、絶対、医師、絶対、サポートされているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I imagine your physicians who relocate alone must receive considerable institutional support.
lines.style: Softer, more reflective. He's thinking aloud—considering something beyond just the logistics. Genuine concern underneath the question. Slight trailing-off as he finishes, like he's still processing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。検査値の、本気で、絶対、誤差、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、慎重に確認します、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We verify test results with the same care. Margin of error is something we won't compromise on.
lines.style: Firm but not sharp. The 'yes' lands with quiet certainty. Patient explanation—she's heard this concern before and respects it. Deliberate pacing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医薬品の、本気で、絶対、国際、絶対、交易、絶対、貴院、絶対、関与されているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Are you saying your hospital participates in international pharmaceutical trade agreements?
lines.style: Deeper reflection now. He's connecting pieces. Quieter than his earlier questions—moving into something that matters to him. Respectful pause before the final word.
